scientific_integrity: Original source already exhibits the six-vertex double-star paradox and a prior family-specific classification covers some instances. Claimed advance is sharp minimality and complete first-order eight-class census; exact exhaustive code and boundaries supplied.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification restricted to connected simple graphs of order at most six, binary payoffs and uniform positive integer capacities; does not imply monotonicity or a classification on larger graphs or with heterogeneous capacities.
title: Sharp six-person onset and complete first-order classification of adverse capacity effects in the Netflix game
